title: Export a frame as an image
summary: Add export settings to a frame and save it as a PNG.

steps.say: Click the Home frame name in the layers list to select it.

check.prompt: Is the Home frame selected, with a blue outline around the whole frame?

hints: Click the frame's name label above it on the canvas.
Press Escape until only the frame is selected.
steps.why: Export settings belong to the selected layer.

steps.say: Make sure the Design tab is open in the right sidebar.

checks.prompt: Is the Design tab active in the right sidebar?

hints: Press Shift E if the Prototype tab is showing.
Design is the first tab under the Share button.
steps.why: Export settings live in the Design tab.

steps.say: Scroll down the right sidebar to Export and click its plus button.

check.prompt: Is an export setting row, such as 1x PNG, shown in the Export section?

hints: Export is the last section of the Design tab.
If a row is already there, you can use it as is.
steps.why: Each row is one file Figma will create.

steps.say: Change 1x to 2x for a sharper image.
hints: Click the scale box on the left of the row to see the options.
Leave the format as PNG for screens.

steps.say: Click the Export Home button under the export row.

checks.prompt: Is a save dialog open, or has a download started?

hints: Control Shift E exports every layer with export settings.
In a browser the file lands in your Downloads folder.
steps.why: Exporting turns the design into a file you can share.

steps.say: If a save window opens, pick a folder and click Save.
hints: Say done if the file downloaded without a window.
Pictures is a good folder to find it later.
steps.why: The image is ready to share or drop into a document.
